scores.reason: Five most consequential claims are quoted verbatim below and tied to current actual outputs or independently bound review receipts. Present and historical artifact boundaries are explicit.

Inferred contract: an internal engineering checkpoint account of implemented behavior, exact bounded validations, storage compatibility, measured resources, retained failures, incomplete parity and next work. The report, acceptance, metrics, gap note, PROGRESS and compatibility/quirk additions satisfy this contract; no user template was supplied.

Technical terms identify actual graph schema, file formats, counters and evidence records. This is internal engineering documentation rather than Liminal product copy; unrelated product-loop/PPA vocabulary rules do not apply. No vague marketing claim, product jargon leak, or dishonest completion label remains.

The premature committed-artifact wording was corrected by the owner. Current text says included/proposed/prepared, while acceptance explicitly records the pending local commit. Full Joern and supplemental parity remain incomplete; reused output is justified through identical executable hashes instead of a fictitious new run.

Current source149/fixture11642 maps and both executables equal final33f. Actual logs give482 tests/80 groups,308 committed and308 fresh live blocks,17 checker tests and73 audited crates. Official actual run exits0 against the eight-field applied manifest. Original dirty state is untouched and the action remains a local checkpoint with no push/merge.

A maintainer can locate the source tests, detailed acceptance/metrics and copied review receipts, distinguish the eleven-case canonical success from full-property gaps, and identify the next three observed include pairs plus separate future policy controls. Local-only large evidence is disclosed; no clone-portability claim is made.
